{{/if}}

templates.body:
{{#with $self as |$self|}}

{{#if (helper_utils '&&' (helper_utils '!==' $self.attributes.template 'tab') (helper_utils '!==' $self.attributes.template 'nav') (helper_utils '!==' $self.attributes.template 'navTab')) }}

  [[attributes.menu.menuData]]
  title = '菜单一'
  key = '1'
  iconUrl = ''
  [[attributes.menu.menuData.children]]
  title = '链接跳转'
  key = '1-1'
  iconUrl = ''
  [[attributes.menu.menuData.children.children]]
  title = '外部链接'
  key = '1-1-1'
  iconUrl = ''
  type = 'link'
  linkTargetBlank = true
  linkUrl = 'https://weda.cloud.tencent.com/index/'
  [[attributes.menu.menuData.children.children]]
  title = '内部链接'
  key = '1-1-2'
  iconUrl = ''
  type = 'route'
  path = '/index'
  [[attributes.menu.menuData]]
  title = '菜单二'
  key = '2'
  iconUrl = ''
  [[attributes.menu.menuData]]
  title = '菜单三'
  key = '3'
  iconUrl = ''
  [[attributes.menu.menuData]]
  title = '菜单四'
  key = '4'
  iconUrl = ''

{{else}}
[attributes.menu]
menuData = []
{{/if}}

{{/with}}

{{#with $self as |$self|}}
{{#if (helper_utils '||' (helper_utils '===' $self.attributes.template 'vertical') (helper_utils '===' $self.attributes.template 'tab'))}}
[[directives]]
":if" = false
{{else}}
[[directives]]
":if" = true
{{/if}}

{{#if (helper_utils '||' (helper_utils '===' $self.attributes.template 'nav') (helper_utils '===' $self.attributes.template 'navTab') )}}

[[template]]
component = 'Container'
[template.extra.commonStyle]
borderBottom = "1px solid #E7E7E7"
display = "flex"
[template.extra.commonStyle.size]
width = "100%"
[template.extra.commonStyle.padding]
top = "16px"
right = "16px"
bottom = "16px"
left = "16px"
[template.extra.commonStyle.flexConfig]
justifyContent = "space-between"
alignItems = "center"
[template.extra.commonStyle.background]
bgType = "color"
color = "rgb(255, 255, 255)"


[[template.items]]
component = 'Container'
[[template.items.items]]
component = 'WdIcon'
[template.items.items.attributes]
name = 'chevronleft'
[[template.items.items.listeners]]
eventName = "tap"
type = "platform"
[template.items.items.listeners.handler]
name = "navigateBack"
module = "platform"
[template.items.items.extra.commonStyle]
cursor = "pointer"
[template.items.items.extra.commonStyle.margin]
right = '16px'

[[template.items.items]]
component = 'WdIcon'
[template.items.items.attributes]
name = 'td:home'
size = 'sm'
[[template.items.items.listeners]]
eventName = "tap"
type = "platform"
[template.items.items.listeners.handler]
name = "relaunchHome"
module = "platform"
[template.items.items.extra.commonStyle]
cursor = "pointer"

[[template.items]]
component = 'Container'
[[template.items.items]]
component = 'WdText'
[template.items.items.attributes]
level = "title-7"
text = "导航标题"
[template.items.items.extra.commonStyle.text]
textAlign = "center"

[[template.items]]
component = 'Container'
[[template.items.items]]
component = 'WdText'
[template.items.items.attributes]
level = "body-sm"
text = "常见问题"
[template.items.items.extra.commonStyle]
cursor = "pointer"
[template.items.items.extra.commonStyle.text]
color = "rgb(0, 82, 217)"

{{else if (helper_utils '!==' $self.attributes.template 'tab') }}
[[template]]
component = 'WdIcon'
[template.attributes]
type = 'custom'
src = 'data:image/png;base64,'
size = 'sm'
[[template.listeners]]
eventName = "tap"
type = "platform"
[template.listeners.handler]
name = "navigateTo"
module = "platform"
[template.listeners.handler.params]
mode = "web"
params = {}
url = "https://developers.weixin.qq.com/community/minihome/mixflow/2300422336543784966"
{{/if}}
{{/with}}

{{#with $self as |$self|}}
{{#if (helper_utils '||' (helper_utils '===' $self.attributes.template 'horizontal') (helper_utils '===' $self.attributes.template 'nav'))}}
[[directives]]
":if" = false
{{else}}
[[directives]]
":if" = true
{{/if}}

{{#if (helper_utils '||' (helper_utils '===' $self.attributes.template 'tab') (helper_utils '===' $self.attributes.template 'navTab'))}}

[[template]]
component = 'WdTabBar'
[[template.attributes.tabs.menuData]]
title = '标签1'
key = '1'
iconUrl = 'td:home'
path= '/index'

title = '标签2'
key = '2'
iconUrl = 'td:app'

title = '标签3'

iconUrl = 'td:user'

{{else if (helper_utils '!==' $self.attributes.template 'nav') }}

[[template]]

src = 'data:image/png;base64,'
size = 'xs'
[[template.listeners]]
eventName = "tap"
type = "platform"
[template.listeners.handler]
name = "navigateTo"
module = "platform"
[template.listeners.handler.params]
mode = "web"
params = {}
url = "https://cloud.tencent.com/document/product/1301"

name = "navigateTo"
module = "platform"

params = {}
url = "https://cloud.tencent.com/document/product/1301"
[template.extra.commonStyle.margin]

{{/if}}

{{/with}}
